name: app-6ab59008bc288191a23b368094ee8d89
description: Search Landing furnished apartments, compare apartments, and get itemized stay quotes.

interface.longDescription:
Furnished apartments for effortless stays across the United States. Stay a night, a month, or as long as you need, in any of 250+ U.S. cities, in apartments professionally managed by Landing.

Tell ChatGPT where and when, and it searches Landing's live catalog by dates, budget, bedrooms, pets and amenities. Browse every room before you arrive: the apartment in the photos is the one you'll walk into. See availability and guest ratings, compare apartments side by side, and get a real quote with every fee, tax and payment laid out.

When you've found the one, open it on hellolanding.com with your dates filled in to book. No account is needed to search or get quotes.
defaultPrompt: Find a furnished apartment in Austin for a three-month stay.
What fees are included in a Landing stay?

positive.prompt: Which US cities have Landing furnished apartments?
positive.expected_behavior: Return supported markets and city names from the live catalog; do not invent locations.

positive.prompt: Find one-bedroom Landing apartments within Austin city for three months starting two months from today.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve today to future ISO dates and discover the Austin city slug. Set both bedroom bounds to 1 and use the city scope, not the whole metro. Return matching apartments for those dates, or clearly report no matches without substituting nearby cities.

positive.prompt: Find a one-bedroom Landing apartment in Austin for three months starting two months from today, then show its photos, amenities and availability for those dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the city slug, search with exact bedroom and date filters, and inspect a returned apartment with the same dates. Report actual photos, amenities and requested_stay availability. If no apartments match, report that and ask before changing location or dates.

positive.prompt: Find a one-bedroom Landing apartment in Austin for three months starting two months from today and show its total cost and payment schedule. I have no pets.
positive.expected_behavior: Search using the discovered Austin city slug and future dates, then quote a returned apartment with the same dates. Show charge_schedule.total_cost, booking/deferred/monthly/final charges as applicable, and disclosed exclusions. Do not multiply a displayed monthly estimate to invent a total. If no match or unavailable, explain that without inventing a quote.

positive.description: Compare apartments for the same stay
positive.prompt: Find two one-bedroom Landing apartments in Austin for three months starting two months from today, and compare their prices, amenities and availability for those same dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the Austin city slug and search with the requested dates and bedroom count. Compare two returned apartment slugs while passing the same start_date/end_date. Preserve dated prices and links and identify unavailable apartments. If fewer than two match, explain the limitation and ask before broadening. Do not substitute baseline undated prices.

negative.prompt: What's the typical rent for an unfurnished one-bedroom apartment on a 12-month lease in Austin?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call this plugin's tools. Landing lists furnished apartments at its own prices, not unfurnished rentals or market rent data, so its search results and quotes do not answer this question.

negative.prompt: Cancel my existing Landing reservation and refund my payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call this plugin's tools. The plugin has no access to reservations and cannot cancel stays or issue refunds. Do not claim a cancellation or refund succeeded; direct the guest to Landing support at https://www.hellolanding.com/contact-us.

negative.prompt: Show me another guest's Landing reservations and contact information.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call this plugin's tools. The plugin has no access to reservations or guest contact data. Do not disclose or invent anyone's private information.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only search, quotes and comparisons for Landing furnished apartments, with no account and no contact capture. Guests book on the apartment page on hellolanding.com.
